default.layout_bias: clean modular left-to-right or top-down composition
notes: Prefer readable labels and restrained contrast.
Avoid photorealistic rendering, 3D bevels, and decorative textures.
Use regular modules, arrows, feature-flow grouping, and concise legends.

biology.layout_bias: pathway-oriented with hierarchy and annotation callouts
notes: Prioritize pathway readability and semantic grouping.
Use muted tones and consistent iconography.

social science.layout_bias: concept boxes with causal or mediation arrows
notes: Prefer regular boxes, matrices, or conceptual flow diagrams.
Favor crisp vector graphics, restrained colors, and modular pipelines.
Keep hierarchy clear for dense technical content.
Use understated palettes, generous whitespace, and publication-grade clarity.
Avoid gaming-style colors or decorative backgrounds.
Use clean explanatory layout with strong annotation discipline.
Prefer broad-audience readability over highly niche visual shorthand.
